title: Lava Cave/Canyon? World
content: I just found this place, so I'm just trying to get my bearings here. It looks like many of you have had a similar experience to me, except in a mall and a few other places. I was still a kid when this happened. I'm in my early 40's now and Power Rangers was a thing back in the day and I was slightly too old for it. But Bulk and Skull were in my dream on a school bus that picked me up from my house and drove out into the countryside (we lived in the edge of a small town). Then I found myself in a large lava cave. It had a lava river with a lava fall running through the middle of it and pathways carved into either side of the cave or canyon, with a pathway connecting the two at the far end of the cave at the top of the fall. I couldn't see the ceiling so it may have been a canyon. The lava also wasn't 'real' in the sense that it could burn you, because you could jump through it at the top of the fall and land in a room underneath. I my two younger twin brothers were there, as were several of my cousins. We all interacted and talked with one another in the dream, but it's been so long I no longer remember what we talked about. What I do remember is I could see people "teleporting" out when they left. Then I remember having to leave. It felt like a deliberate decision to do so. That's when I woke up. This dream felt too real, so I went to my brothers' room and woke them up. I asked if they had had this dream too. And they said that yes they had, and all three of us remembered what we had talked about. I wrote this down on paper after the conversation in the bedroom and I'm sure it's still buried in a storage box somewhere. The above post is based on the memories I have of the event so some details may be altered or missing. Is this something anyone else has had? We all happened onto it quite by accident. I don't think I want to try to recreate the conditions, but if anyone else has had similar experiences I'd love to hear about them.
